# Sidebar menus for DeepSeek Harness
简体中文 · MIT license
Show or hide sidebar panel entries and add shortcuts to Settings sections. Existing panels use their
actual sidebar names, not the shorter names of their corresponding Settings sections.
## Screenshots
### Manage visibility
### Settings shortcuts in the sidebar
Screenshots show two example configurations. Captured and provided by the plugin author for publicat
enshots show two example configurations. Captured and provided by the plugin author for publication.
## Install
Requires DeepSeek Harness Web or Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer (`engines.dsh: >=0.2.2-rc.1`) with the
sidebar, Settings and layout client APIs. The Harness refuses to install the plugin where the runnin
g version does not satisfy that range. The plugin ships directly loadable JavaScript: no build, inst
all scripts or additional runtime dependencies. React and the client store are supplied by the Harne
ditional runtime dependencies. React and the client store are supplied by the Harness module loader.
Ask your Harness agent:
> Install the GitHub plugin github:zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar
Or install into your active CLI profile (`desktop` below is the Desktop profile; substitute your own
install into your active CLI profile (`desktop` below is the Desktop profile; substitute your own):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Alternatively, download `dsh-settings-sidebar.tgz` from Releases and run:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For a pinned version, use `github:zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar#v1.4.0`. The package keeps its inter
nal identifier `@local/dsh-settings-sidebar`; it is distributed through GitHub/tarballs, not npm.
## Use

1. Open **Sidebar menus** from the sidebar or Settings.
2. Search for a menu and toggle its visibili

ty. Existing panels, More and the manager itself are included.
3. If you hide the manager, reopen **
Settings → Sidebar menus** to restore it.
Where a menu opens depends on whether its content has a main page. Entries with their own main-conte
nt page open that page in the main content area, exactly as the original sidebar button does; entrie
s that exist only as a Settings section have no main page, so they open the Settings dialog already
positioned on that section. Such a dialog does not replace the page you were on: closing it leaves t
hat page selected, and if that page's plugin has been removed the shortcut falls back to the convers
ation. The Plugins inventory page and the built-in-plugin Settings section are separate entries.
Hiding an entry does not disable its plugin, delete its page or remove its Settings entry. New Sessi
on, workspace browsing and account/Settings controls are outside the panel-menu scope; Settings rema
ins available for recovery.
## Data and safety
Visibility choices stay in this client's `localStorage`. No network requests, account/model/Host con
figuration changes, session-data changes or model tools are added. Preferences do not sync between c
lients. First-version pins are migrated; failed saves report an error and preserve the current state
. Uninstalling removes policy styles and added shortcuts, restoring original panels. Local preferenc
es remain for reinstalls.
## Compatibility and limitations
The current host has no public filter for every original sidebar panel. Original entries are hidden
by a stylesheet rendered in `shell.overlay`, scoped to the global navigation and complete button acc
essibility names. Labels are CSS-string escaped and follow locale changes. The plugin does not read
or rewrite other plugins' DOM or replace the sidebar. New Settings shortcuts use ordinary slot regis
trations and disposers.
- Hiding affects sidebar navigation rows only. More's popup or other locations may still expose the

same function.
- Two original entries with exactly the same display name are hidden together.
- The
plugin depends on current navigation markup, `layout.panelInfo` subscription and the Settings shell'
s shared Store `openSection` action. Host upgrades require revalidation. Settings navigation failure

s are reported in the manager.
- Existing panels default to visible; Settings shortcuts without an e
xisting sidebar entry default to hidden.
The SVG icon is original artwork; the storefront PNG is converted from it. No third-party UI artwork
is original artwork; the storefront PNG is converted from it. No third-party UI artwork is bundled.
## Development and verification
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Node's built-in tests cover names, original/self visibility, shortcut lifecycle, persistence/migrati
on, failed storage, preserved modal backgrounds and listener disposal. Installed Desktop checks also
exercised original-panel hiding, manager recovery through Settings and closing Models Settings back
onto the Plugins page. These checks are not a cross-version compatibility guarantee.
